messages:
anjali: heads up — seeing repeated 95th-pctl egress spikes from shared-gpu pool in us-west2 since ~07:10 UTC, correlated to tenant 'ml-corp'. small gen latency up ~2x for many customers.
infra-bot: Alert: egress-bandwidth-high on pool/shared-gpu/us-west2 (hosts: gpu-uw2-{12,14,18}) — triggered at 07:11 UTC
anjali: sampled pcap + flow logs — sustained tx bursts ~250-400Mbps per host for 4-6m. no GPU mem OOMs, CPU fine. requests are long-sequence generate calls (token counts 1.5x baseline)
tom: any KV-cache eviction noise? last time that route looked like cache churn -> more model tokens -> more egress
anjali: checked kvcache metrics: hit rate dropped 18% for ml-corp slice around same window. eviction spikes align with tenant bursts.
kevin: ok. two levers: (A) soft-police egress on tenant slice, (B) migrate tenant to a dedicated/reserved slice for a few hours. (A) cheaper and quick, (B) costlier but stable.
priya: (B) needs sales + billing OK, they'd be charged reserved-minutes. (A) risks tail latency for that tenant. can we do (A) w/ temporary graceful shaping?
tom: propose soft-shaping policy: 100Mbps burstable to 300Mbps with token-bucket refill 30s, duration 15m. if spikes continue -> auto-evict to preemptible/dedicated fallback.
kevin: I can push a quick eBPF policer on node-level. patch command:

```
kubectl exec -n infra egress-controller-0 -- /bin/sh -c "./policer apply --slice ml-corp --rate 100mbit --burst 300mbit --window 900"
```

kevin: will add annotation to scheduler so subsequent allocations avoid shared slots for tenant for 30m.
anjali: can we also try routing fallback: prefer quantized-variant model (q4) for that tenant while shaping is active? should cut tokens ~20%.
priya: they're sensitive to quality regression. need to run smoke eval on a small traffic fraction before blanket switch. canary it to 5% of requests.
tom: ops-runbook-bot — trigger canary rollout for ml-corp: route 5% -> q4-variant, monitor latency+quality for 10m
ops-runbook-bot: Canary rollout started for tenant=ml-corp routes -> q4-variant (5%). Monitoring metrics: latency, perplexity-proxy, kvcache-hit.
anjali: rolling the eBPF policer now on gpu-uw2-12 and gpu-uw2-14. will watch 95th-pctl.
kevin: policer applied on hosts. tagging slice with qos=soft-evict-30m :thumbsup:
anjali: early signal: 95th pctl on those hosts dropped ~45% in 2m. kvcache hit still low but burst curtailed.
priya: canary q4 started. initial quality delta within threshold on small eval set.
anjali: OK turning on auto-evict rule if we see a repeat within 45m: move slice -> preemptible pool and alert sales for dedicated upsell.
kevin: note for postmortem: consider adding a dedicated egress budget for heavy tokenizer tenants or auto-reserve when avg token/session > X
tom: also: add a detection signal for kvcache-hit-drop + sustained tx to route to shaping earlier.
anjali: filing follow-up: create runbook step to try shaping -> canary q-variant -> auto-evict -> notify billing. will open RFC for egress budgeting.
infra-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-103. assignees: anjali, kevin, tom. severity: S2.
priya: thanks all — ping me if we need to notify the customer support team to prep comms.
anjali: noted. leaving policer for 15m, will update thread in 20m with final state.
